document.name: Diamondheart Bushwick Kids Programs
document.shortDescription: Bushwick martial arts after-school classes for ages 4-12 with youth Brazilian jiu-jitsu and Muay Thai training.
document.longDescription:
Diamondheart Brooklyn's official programs page includes a dedicated kids offering labeled Kids Programs for ages 4 to 12. The page describes a safe, structured environment where children build confidence, discipline, coordination, and self-defense skills through age-appropriate Brazilian jiu-jitsu and Muay Thai training.

The same official page tags the youth program as After-School Classes and identifies the business as Diamondheart Striking & Grappling at 67 Ingraham Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn, with phone +1-718-662-6108 and email Physicalculturecollective@gmail.com. The public page does not publish exact session times, so this listing keeps the schedule language conservative and uses only the source-backed weekday after-school framing.

Sources: https://teamdiamondheart.com/programs https://teamdiamondheart.com/images/og/og-default.jpg
